stemMd: Participants volunteer for a study and are then randomly assigned to one of two exercise programmes. What is most directly supported by the random assignment?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A guarantee that every participant completes the programme

options.label: B
options.textMd: Proof that both programmes are equally effective

options.label: C
options.textMd: A fairer comparison of programme effects among the participants

options.label: D
options.textMd: Proof that the volunteers represent every adult

explanationMd: Random assignment helps balance pre-existing differences between programme groups, supporting causal comparison within the study. It does not make the volunteers representative of all adults or establish a result in advance.

distractorRationale.d: Random assignment is not random population sampling.
distractorRationale.b: That is an outcome to investigate.
